item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i dbang gi go rim khrigs su sdeb pa bde chen snying po
item.coloph: ces sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa rig 'dzin gsang ba mthar thug gi dbang khrid go rim bde chen snying po 'di yang sngon dus gter byon du bzhugs lding sor yong bas dngos su ma 'byor ba'i stabs grub pa'i skyes chen zab mo don la dga' ba 'ga' yis yang yang bskul ba dang / khyad par du dus 'dir 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba/ rnal 'byor chen po yar me nyi ma rgyal mtshan ched du bskul ba la bstan te/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis sngar gnas rjes dran gyi rigs pad ma'i tshig gis kha bskang ste/ thugs sprul ri bo chen po'i mdun zhol stag rtse yang dben du sbyar zhing yi ge pa ni a yu rdor dzas bgyis pas bstan 'gro smin cing grol ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
